died.name: Catharine Beecher
died.last_words: I hope to be in Phil. in about ten days. I am stronger than for yrs. but take no new responsibilities.

died.name: Eugène Ysaÿe
died.cause: Belgian violinist, composer and conductor, after his Fourth Sonata was played for him
died.last_words: Splendid. The finale just a little too fast.

died.name: Leonel Torres Herrera
died.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
died.last_words: I am innocent, innocent, innocent. Make no mistake about this. I owe society nothing. Continue the struggle for human rights, helping those who are innocent, especially Mr. Graham. I am an innocent man, and something very wrong is taking place tonight. May God bless you all. I am ready.

born.name: George Cathcart
born.cause: prior to his death at the Battle of Inkerman
born.last_words: I fear we are in a mess.

born.name: Edward Lear
born.last_words: I did not answer the letters of my friends because I could not write, as no sooner did I take a pen in my hand than I felt as if I was dying.

born.name: Dante Gabriel Rossetti
born.last_words: Then you really think I am dying? At last you think so. But I was right from the first.

born.name: Frederick Holder
born.desc: Speaker of the Australian House of Representatives
born.cause: prior to collapsing in the House after a tumultuous all-night session
